settings.title: Drive Energy Doc: settings
settings.description: Applies to all vehicles. The Companion app channel needs no account, Telegram needs a bot, WhatsApp a Meta business account. Afterwards add vehicles (add the integration again).

data.channels: How should Drive Energy Doc talk to you?
data.electric_price: Electricity price €/kWh (EV only, number or entity)
data.ai_task_entity: AI for reading receipts (empty = Gemini automatically)

price_key.title: Tankerkoenig
price_key.description: For prices in Germany. Free key at creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de, or leave empty (the receipt is enough).

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Cloud API
whatsapp.description: Credentials from the Meta developer portal, see README. Webhook address: /api/drive_energy_doc/whatsapp

data.wa_template: Template name (WhatsApp template with one variable, for messages after 24 h)

vehicle.title: Add vehicle
vehicle.description:
{plate_preview}

Choose the country of the plate. After “OK” you see the plate drawn with the chosen country before anything is saved.

data.name: Name
data.image_upload: Upload a vehicle picture (alternative to the image entity, takes precedence)

messaging.title: Messaging for this vehicle
messaging.description: Grouped by channel. “Send test message” checks a channel right away with the values you entered, before anything is saved. Only the channels you chose in the settings.

whatsapp.description: The driver's number. Credentials are in the settings.

telegram.description: Own bot or own chat per vehicle.
